podcast.title: Origins in San Diego (1991)
podcast.body: Screamo appears to have originated in San Diego as early as 1991, predating the mainstream emo explosion of the 2000s and suggesting an earlier, more underground development. "And it seems to have started in San Diego as early as 1991."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Aggressive Music Progression
podcast.body: Screamo was described as the further progression of punk, hardcore, and post-hardcore. Dallas Green specifically cited bands from the "deep head early first-screamo stuff" as influences for Alexis on Fire's sound, highlighting its role in shaping their distinct style. "You have punk, which turns into hardcore, which turns into post-hardcore, which becomes screamo and all that sort of weirdness, right?"

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Alexisonfire - In Their Own Words Podcast

podcast.title: Darker, Louder, More Intense Emo
podcast.body: Screamo is described as a darker, louder, and even more intense form of emo, distinguishing itself through its sonic aggression and often political themes. "And then there was Screamo, a darker, louder, even more intense form of emo."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Subgenre of Third Wave Emo
podcast.body: Screamo emerged as one of the fragmented variations and subgenres within the third wave of emo. "Emo-pop, screamo bands, just a couple of examples."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
